summary: Comprehensive testing of Blog RSS Feed, Analytics, and Auto-Scheduling features completed successfully. All 27 backend API tests pass. Frontend Blog Analytics page at /admin/blog-analytics fully functional with KPI cards, charts, schedule toggles, and RSS links.
critical_code_review_comments: RSS feed properly returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with Atom namespace
Blog tracking events stored with date field for efficient daily aggregation
Analytics aggregation uses MongoDB pipelines with proper date filtering
Schedule config persisted in DB with upsert pattern, defaults returned if not set
Frontend uses proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Toast notifications properly integrated using Sonner
seed_data_creation: Created test analytics events with blog_ids: test-blog-123, test-blog-456, integration-test-*
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog RSS, Analytics, and Auto-Schedule features fully functional. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_blog_rss_analytics_schedule.py covers all endpoints. Admin page at /admin/blog-analytics. RSS feed public at /api/blog/rss. Event tracking public at POST /api/blog/track.
